newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-SAQLAIN STRIKES BEFORE SRI LANKA CLEAR DEFICIT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SAQLAIN STRIKES BEFORE SRI LANKA CLEAR DEFICIT.

text.p: Pakistan off-spinner Saqlain Mushtaq struck an early blow before Sri Lanka cleared their first innings deficit on the fourth day of the first test on Tuesday.
Saqlain induced opener Russell Arnold into a false stroke, having him caught at mid-off by Shahid Nazir for 15.
Sri Lanka, trailing Pakistan by 48, went to lunch at 45 for one, with Marvan Atapattu on 20 and Aravinda de Silva on seven.
With regular opener Sanath Jayasuriya still on the sick list, Atapattu was promoted from number three to open the innings.
Pakistan's last pair lasted a further 35 minutes at the start of the day before the touring side were dismissed for 378.
Their first innings ended with Saqlain being run out for 58, having batted for five hours and hit five fours.
Playing the ball to the covers, Saqlain was beaten by Arnold's direct throw to the non-striker's end. Mohammed Zahid was left unbeaten on six, having held out for 97 minutes with Saqlain.
Off-spinner Muthiah Muralitharan, who was not used in the morning session, had the best figures of six for 98.
